description: This file defines a final class 'Encoding' that provides static methods for reading, decoding, and encoding strings from and to binary buffers, primarily used for low-level data serialization/deserialization within the AWS CRT internal namespace.

classes.name: Encoding
classes.description: A utility class for encoding and decoding strings to binary format, optimizing for internal data transmission or storage.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads a length-prefixed string from the buffer, updates the buffer to point after the read string.

methods.name: readStrings
methods.description: Reads multiple strings from the buffer until the buffer is exhausted.

methods.name: decodeString
methods.description: Decodes a length-prefixed string from the buffer, returning the length and string.

methods.name: encodeString
methods.description: Encodes a string or array element into a length-prefixed binary format.
